deep_analysis:
MARKET: BTC 1m at 78,673 vs EMA300 78,008 (+0.85% above, held above for hours), 15m aggregate LONG_BIAS 90/3/30 of 123 tokens, regimes.BTC LONG_BIAS (conf 59.2), continuum ABOVE, trend_quality STRONG_UP — but volatility and volume are LOW, so this is a slow grind, not an explosive trend. Flip rate 16 aggregate / 16 BTC per 24h (normal p50 band ~19-20, no churn anomaly) and both direction sources agree LONG_BIAS. We are LONG-only 3/3, so we are on the right side of the tape.

OPEN TRADES (all three opened within 20 minutes, all LONG, +0.05 unrealized):
1) ENS #16539 LONG @4.8095, meta_rsi 85.71 (EXTREME chase), confidence 75, now 4.8325 (+0.48%), 30m +0.46%. Stop sits at 4.8123 — ABOVE entry (+0.06%), so downside is already locked at a small profit and TP 4.882 (+1.5%) is the only open question. Would I open fresh at 85.7? No — this is a top-of-band chase and the worst RSI entry class we have — but the position is effectively a free ride, so the answer is HOLD, not exit. ENS 15m regime LONG_BIAS conf 92.8 → aligned. Verify the stop: a LONG stop above entry is either an intentional breakeven move or a fat-finger, and it should be confirmed on the exchange (steer below).
2) BTC #16538 LONG @78575, meta_rsi 66.14, stop = entry (breakeven at open), TP 79020 (+0.56%). Risk-free, aligned with the tape we spent all day shorting and losing on. Would open fresh: yes. Note the TP is only +0.56% — fine while the stop is at entry, but this trade cannot pay for a bad week; let the trail work rather than banking 0.5%.
3) ADA #16537 LONG @0.19376, meta_rsi 66.67, confidence 41.6 (lowest of the three), volatility EXTREME, now 0.19462 (+0.44%) with 1h MFE already 0.54% — trail threshold (+0.40%) has been reached, trailing_activated still False in PG. SL -0.69% / TP +2.2% (R:R ~3.2). ADA 15m LONG_BIAS conf 93.2 → aligned. 30m momentum is flat (-0.01%), so the coin is grinding, not pumping. Would open fresh: marginal yes on regime, no on confidence 41.6 — treat it as the one position that can still lose real money (steer below).

WRONG-SIDE AUDIT (7 losses / -$0.75 in 24h): two of the seven were BTC SHORTs fired into an above-EMA300 tape — #16533 continuum-trend- at meta_rsi 62.6 (-5.31%) and #16518 continuum-osc- at meta_rsi 67.2 (-7.32%) — while every winning SHORT of the day was entered after a deep pullback: CRV 42.9 (+33.9%), CRV 35.8 (+6.9%), YGG 36.4 (+1.1%), BTC 35.2 (+1.0%). The WINNING side was either long the tape or short only into oversold; we were on the wrong side by shorting strength during an uptrend. Four of the seven were LONGs at meta_rsi 70-75 that never armed (COMP mfe -0.00, GRASS mfe 0.03, WLFI mfe 0.28) and exited via trail_arm_timeout/stale_exit — the chase band bleeding exactly as the chop-bleed KPI says it does. The seventh (BLUR, rsi 53.9) reached mfe 1.35% and gave it back through ugb_pt — the only exit-ownership loss of the day.

CHOP-BLEED KPI (dollar share, quoted with both companions): 7d 94.8% (52 of 60 losers had mfe<0.40; 0 NULL mfe_pct) vs 14d 90.5% (118/146) and 30d 84.0% (284/368). Same-day arm rate companion 85.7% (6 of 7). 7d LONG arm rate 56.8% (54/95) — tripwire <50 not tripped. 7d exit breakdown: atr_sl_hit 13T/0W/-$1.52, hard_max_loss 8T/0W/-$1.18, cut-loser-CL-T1 8T/0W/-$1.10, trail_arm_timeout 22T/7W/-$0.48 versus profit-monster-trail 55T/53W/+$2.95. 94.8% is above the 92% line = entry-quality deterioration, which routes to entry-quality filters (brain-auditor), not exit tweaks. Standing, age=2 cycles unexecuted.

CORRECTION TO LAST CYCLE'S BAND CLAIM: the previous cycle wrote that "center band 45-60 remains the preferred entry zone." Fresh 7d meta_rsi band measurement run this cycle does not support it — LONG 45-59 is the WORST long cell (n=42, 20W 47.6%, -$0.56) while LONG <45 is the best (n=11, 8W, +$0.48), LONG 60-69 +$0.12 (n=20), LONG 70+ -$0.15 (n=18); SHORT <45 is the best short cell (n=32, 20W, +$0.77) and SHORT 45-69 is the bleed (-$0.74 over 14T). The precheck tool independently prints the same direction ("RSI 45-55 death zone, 7d 15-22%WR"). n is small per cell and no p-value was computed, so this is an observation, NOT a proven pattern — and signal-parameter changes are the brain auditor's job regardless. Practical read: the one thing both the data and the death-zone advisory agree on is that mid-band is not where the money is this week; the money is in trend-aligned extremes.

POSITIONING: 3/3 long in a LONG_BIAS tape = aligned, but all three opened within 20 minutes and all three are directionally the same bet — one BTC dump hits all of them. The cluster steers (001-004) remain valid, with one material mitigation the automated engine does not see: ENS's stop is above entry and BTC's stop is at entry, so only ADA can lose real money (-0.69% price, ~-3.5% at 5x). Max portfolio downside is roughly ADA's stop plus slippage, not three full stops. Capital efficiency is healthy (3 positions on a fresh tape, hot_set empty); the opportunity cost is the EXTREME-regime runners we are not in (SOPH +15.4%, PROVE +7.3% blacklisted, SUPER +6.6%, RUNE +5.4%, ARB +4.5% over 16 candles) — all of which the RR engine grades C/D, so not chasing them is defensible.

PENDING-SIGNAL HYGIENE: signals.json currently holds 3 PENDING LONGs — COMP at RSI 90, GRASS at RSI 80.05, BLUR at RSI 68. COMP is the one to watch: we lost -4.34% on COMP LONG 13h ago (#16526), COMP's own 15m regime is SHORT_BIAS conf 85.5, and RSI 90 is far above SIGNAL_FILTER_RSI_MAX=72, so the RSI gate should block it before it fills. If a COMP long at RSI 90 ever reaches the books, the gate is broken — that is a bug report, not a trade.

AUTO-TRADER: shadow, MANAGE_ONLY, regime CHOP with long score -10 / short -30, one armed short trigger 2.6% below price (age 210m) — a breakdown-fade order, harmless in shadow. Its own scorecard is 34.5% WR over n=29 with longs 25% WR (-$0.09) and shorts 46.2% WR (+$0.17), i.e. its shadow book agrees with the tape: shorting strength pays, longing in CHOP does not.

AI TRADER: PICK (watchlist only — AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False, will NOT execute): USELESS LONG, conf 68, price 0.13609, rsi_at_pick 59.5. Precheck PASS (ATR 5.63%, RR 2.11 grade D but clears the 0.70 hard floor, 30d WR gate ok, not blacklisted / not in losers or penalty, price age 5min). Regime: 15m LONG_BIAS conf 95, +4.26% over 16 candles, BTC 1m above EMA300 → aligned. Caveats: EXTREME volatility regime, RSI 59.5 is upper-mid band (and mid band is this week's worst long cell), RR score 43 <50 is shadow-blocked by the rr-engine, and firing would make the book 4/4 long. Invalidation: BTC 1m loses EMA300 ~78,008 for 10m+, RSI drift >15pts at fire time, or USELESS 30m momentum turns negative. Previous pick INJ (2026-10-29 14:19) was not rejected — no rejected_at — it simply aged out.

RETRACTIONS / NO-ACTIONS THIS CYCLE: the measured-refuted steer "keep LONG entries out of meta_rsi 45-64 while BTC 1m below EMA300" is NOT re-issued (brain_auditor #139 measured the blocked cell as the profitable one). bb-bounce-v2-long+ (7d 10T 1W -$0.39) is NOT re-proposed for a kill — #138 measured kill bars FAIL and the bypass-removal lever is in flight; watch, auditor owns it, age=2 cycles. volume-buildup- (7d 37T 22W -$0.44, VOLUME_BUILDUP_MINUS_ENABLED=True, live traffic) stands as a size/R:R-asymmetry look for the auditor, age=2 cycles — not a disable. pump-chain+ 7d 23T 13W -$0.08 is breakeven, no action. Brain search endpoint returned no results this cycle (empty response) — no cross-session context available.
regime_context:
Sources stated separately because they can disagree: 15m regime scanner aggregate = LONG_BIAS (90 long / 3 short / 30 neutral of 123 tokens, dumped 05:30 UTC); regimes.BTC = LONG_BIAS (conf 59.2); btc_15m = LONG_BIAS; btc_4h = NEUTRAL; continuum = BTC 1m ABOVE EMA300 (price 78,673 vs 78,008, +0.85%), linreg_15m positive, trend_quality STRONG_UP. Flip rate 16 aggregate / 16 BTC per 24h over 96 dumps — inside the normal p50 band (~19-20), so NOT an instability flag (the p95 anomaly line is 26). Both direction sources currently agree LONG_BIAS, so no source conflict to disclose.

Meaning for positions: LONGs are aligned; a SHORT is counter-trend until BTC 1m closes back below EMA300 ~78,008 for 10m+. Volatility LOW / volume LOW (volume_ratio 0.34) means a slow grind — which is the regime where armed trails win (7d profit-monster-trail 55T 53W +$2.95) and fresh chase entries die (94.8% of loss from never-armed trades). Continuum's market_phase label reads DECLINING / wyckoff UNKNOWN, which is stale versus the live 1m tape — use the live EMA300 position as the tie-break, and state that source when writing any direction-flavored steer.

1) Shorting strength in an uptape (BTC continuum shorts) — 24h n=4: SHORTS at meta_rsi 62.6 / 67.2 lost -$0.18 (-5.31%) and -$0.25 (-7.32%); SHORTS at meta_rsi 35.2 / 58.5 won +$0.03 and +$0.01. 7d corroboration by band: SHORT <45 n=32 62.5% WR +$0.77 vs SHORT 45-69 n=14 -$0.74. WINNING SIDE: long the tape, or short only after a deep pullback (rsi <45). WHY WE WEREN'T ON IT: continuum-osc-/trend- fired shorts on local oscillator strength while the 1m held EMA300 all day. n is small and no p-value computed → watch, not a gate; re-measure before proposing any filter.

2) Never-armed chop bleed — 7d dollar share 94.8% (52/60 losers with mfe<0.40, 0 NULL mfe_pct), 14d 90.5%, 30d 84.0%; same-day arm companion 85.7% (6/7); 7d LONG arm 56.8% (54/95, tripwire <50 not tripped). Exits: atr_sl_hit 13T 0W -$1.52, hard_max_loss 8T 0W -$1.18, cut-loser-CL-T1 8T 0W -$1.10, trail_arm_timeout 22T 7W -$0.48 vs profit-monster-trail 55T 53W +$2.95. Above the 92% line → entry-quality filters (brain auditor), NOT exit tuning. Standing 2 cycles.

3) High-band long chase (meta_rsi 70-75) — 24h 3 wins (CAKE 70.8, ETC 71.4, CASHCAT 73.9) vs 4 losses (GRASS 72.6, COMP 70.8, WLFI 75.0, FARTCOIN 70.3); the four losers never armed (mfe 0.03/0.00/0.28) and exited trail_arm_timeout/stale_exit, FARTCOIN exited ugb_pt. 7d LONG 70+ = n=18 10W -$0.15. No claim on small n — the observed fact is only that above 70 we get neither arm nor payoff this week, and the wins there are the same chase band.

4) Mid-band is not safe either (correction of prior cycle) — 7d LONG 45-59: n=42, 20W 47.6%, -$0.56 = the worst long cell; LONG <45 n=11 8W +$0.48; LONG 60-69 n=20 13W +$0.12. Precheck's independent death-zone advisory (45-55, 7d 15-22%WR) points the same way. n small, no significance test, and parameter changes are banned for this role → observation for the auditor, nothing more.

5) Volume/buildup short family — volume-buildup- 7d n=37 22W 59% but -$0.44: winners smaller than losers. Enabled with live traffic (VOLUME_BUILDUP_MINUS_ENABLED=True) → normal flag for an auditor look at size/R:R asymmetry, NOT a disable. age=2 cycles.
